build_feature_extractor_vgg: build a FeatureExtractor model using a pretrained VGG16 encoder for multi-scale feature extraction
build_feature_extractor_resnet: build a FeatureExtractor model using a ResNet50 encoder with gradient checkpointing enabled
create_decoder_block: create a DecoderBlock that upsamples features and concatenates with skip connections from the encoder
create_adaptation_block: create an AdaptationBlock with a 1x1 convolution to project feature channels to a target dimension
run_feature_extraction_forward: run the FeatureExtractor forward pass on an image tensor to get multi-scale feature maps
